title: Concept: ASP.NET trace application disclosed in a response
description: The ASP.NET trace viewer lists recent requests with their headers, session identifiers, form and query values. When it is reachable it discloses other users' request data, not just the application layout, and the session identifiers alone are enough to hijack a live session.
applicability: Responses served by an ASP.NET application with tracing enabled.
risk: The caller reads other users' session identifiers, form values and request headers, which enables session hijacking and discloses the application's internal request shapes.
